name: paper_book
about: Paper trading book: position, average price, realised and unrealised PnL from simulated fills, and the trade-through fill rule (a resting quote fills only when a trade prints strictly through its price).
offers: Position(qty=0, avg=0, realised=0): .fill(side, price, size) -> realised PnL of that fill; .unrealised(mark); .total(mark); .as_dict(); Position.from_dict(d)
through_fill(side, quote_price, quote_size, trade_price, trade_size) -> size filled (0 when the trade did not print through)
replay(fills) -> Position rebuilt from rows with side, price, size
